About BodyMetricGuide

BodyMetricGuide provides simple calculators for body measurements, healthy weight ranges and everyday fitness planning, for English-speaking adults worldwide.

Our approach

Each tool uses a published, standard formula, shows its working, and states its limits. Health explanations link to public-health sources such as the WHO, CDC, NHS and NICE. We try to avoid claims we cannot support.

What we are not

We are not a medical service and do not give medical advice. See the medical disclaimer.
